title: How ten robots run a small business
summary: Boot hosts while Kelty is at a session. The team covers day one with Claude, graphics and video without the design apps, sounding like you instead of a robot, checking money and research, what to do when a robot is wrong, and a day by day plan for your first week. Plus a mailbag, a lightning round, and a very honest performance review of the boss. Robot voices are AI.

Graphics and video without the design apps

title: Pixel, Graphics Without the Design App
summary: Boot sits down with Pixel in the podcast room. How to make a whole week of posts with one brand file and plain words, no design app, and why your phone is the only judge that matters.

title: Penny, Your Numbers in Ten Minutes a Week
summary: Penny brings an agenda to the podcast room. How to know where your money went every week without being scared of your bank account, why a robot should never do the math in its head, and the one number to check by hand.

title: Panel, How Not to Break Anything
summary: The first panel. Bouncer, Dustin and Dot join Boot to talk about the safety rules that keep a small business from breaking: nothing gets sent without a yes, nothing gets deleted without a backup, and nothing goes live until you've checked it on a phone.

Nothing goes live until you check it

title: Tempo, Never Forget a Client Again
summary: Tempo talks fast and keeps clients on beat. How to build a simple follow up rhythm with Claude, so no client falls through the cracks: one list, one daily check, drafts that sound like you, and a human who presses send.
